packageRules.description: VGS -- this repo's own modules (starlarky parent, larky, runlarky, libstarlark); versions are managed by release-please, not Renovate
VGS -- GitHub Actions: all non-major updates grouped
VGS -- Dockerfile base images: non-major tag bumps, grouped with Maven plugins

VGS -- Dockerfile digest-only refreshes, in their own branch. A digest-pinned image (tag + @sha256) produces TWO updates sharing the same packageFile+depName+currentValue: the tag bump and a digest-only refresh. When both land in one branch, Renovate's branchify dedup drops one and logs 'Ignoring upgrade collision', so the image silently stops being updated at all. Keeping digests in a separate branch is what prevents that collision.

Pin the Python interpreter minor version. For the python image a 'minor' bump (e.g. 3.10 -> 3.11) is effectively a language major, so disable it. Patch (3.10.x) and digest rebuilds are still allowed; major is already off via docker:disableMajor. Placed after the docker image groups so it overrides for python only.
VGS -- Maven plugins: grouped with build images (same groupName)
VGS -- Python dependencies (pylarky): minor + patch grouped by language
VGS -- Java runtime minor+patch catch-all: groups all maven minor/patch updates not claimed by a namespace rule below (those ship later in the array and override this groupName)
packageRules.groupName: Java runtime minor and patch updates

packageRules.description: VGS -- com.google namespace (guava, flogger, auto-value, error-prone, re2j, tink, protobuf, gson)
VGS -- org.graalvm namespace (sdk + native build tools) kept together
VGS -- crypto providers (bouncycastle, wss4j): security-sensitive and the backbone of Larky's crypto modules, so they ship in a dedicated PR rather than blended into the general runtime group

VGS -- Test and dev dependencies: minor + patch grouped across ecosystems. Placed after the maven namespace rules so test-scoped artifacts (e.g. com.google.truth) land here instead of in their namespace group.
VGS -- test frameworks by name, for artifacts whose scope Renovate cannot see (e.g. versions declared in dependencyManagement)
